verdicts.reason: A: the cream circle is cut off from the can and sits alone in the bottom-right corner as a meaningless blob. The can is shrunk, which leaves dead space in the middle. The logo and the NEW VIDEO badge have swapped sides compared with the original, and a bokeh dot sits on the 'We' of the subtitle. B: the logo and badge stay where the original put them and the can is larger, but the circle is still offset, so the can only half-overlaps it in a way that looks accidental. The lower half of B also has dead space and the same dot collision on the subtitle. Both are broken, but B is less so.
